exposure: large loop excision of transformation zone (LLETZ)
Large loop excision of the transformation zone (LLETZ)
Gestational age at preterm birth (<28, <32, <34, <37 weeks)
cohort: All women giving birth to singletons in Slovenia between 2003 and 2012 (N=192,730)
finding: Women with a history of cold-knife conisation or LLETZ had significantly increased odds of spontaneous preterm birth, particularly before 28 and 32 weeks of gestation.
